# Job Description

Job Application for Business Development Representative - French Speaker at Scandit

# Business Development Representative - French Speaker

London

Apply

**Business Development Representative - French Speaker**

**Scandit London**

**Imagine the What. Build the How.**

Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows and provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

**About the Role**

We are currently seeking a **Business** **Development Representative professionally fluent in French and English** to strengthen our sales team based in London, spending 2-3 days per week in our office near Moorgate. You will be a key part of our global sales team, offering Scandit’s disruptive AI-powered software-based mobile barcode scanning solutions and innovative data capture solutions to enterprise and mid-sized customers. Our target markets include businesses mainly in retail, transport and logistics.

**Our Approach To Work**

This is a hybrid role. You will work from our London office 2-3 days per week, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days. You need to live within commuting distance of Moorgate, London.

**What You Will Do**

- Generate pre-sale opportunities through targeted outreach via phone, email, social and others.
- Qualify leads related to target accounts efficiently and effectively to increase conversion rates and value to pipeline.
- Perform qualification calls with high level prospects that assess commercial, technical and product fit.
- Consistent delivery of quality outreach that drives engagement in senior personas in target accounts.
- Research named accounts based on quarterly performance, organisational challenges, executive personnel changes, market conditions, and existing technology.
- Orchestrate discussions with senior executives around their business needs
- Set up meetings and demos for Account Executives
- Maintain lead, account, contact, and opportunity data across  CRM platforms.
- Keep detailed and accurate notes of all sales related activities
- Work closely with the Account Executives and field marketeers by country and/or vertical.

**Who You Are**

- **1 or more years of tech sales** or related market experience with exposure sales/client outreach within software/SaaS (mobile a plus)
- **Fluent in French and English**, additional languages are a plus
- **Strong desire to learn and succeed** in **value and solution based sales of complex innovative AI powered tech solutions**.
- **Excel** in a **fast-paced start-up** environment and able to **quickly adapt to change**.
- **Excellent** interpersonal and written/spoken **communication skills**.
- **Energetic, enthusiastic, confident and committed** to make calls to C-level IT and Business decision makers as part of the role
- **AI fluent** to help you in your current role and are always looking to innovate
- **Willing to go beyond your role**, your team and (sometimes) your comfort zone to make a cross-functional impact on the business

**We support your sales career**

- World-class tech stack to make you as productive as possible
- Company business development onboarding track to get you generating and converting leads fast.
- Regular regional and company-wide sales events to ensure collaboration, communication and alignment.
- Flat, accessible leadership structure to support in commercial activities: win as a team.
- Visible progression path to Sales and Management opportunities through tailored enablement programme.
- Collaborative culture: you will not do it alone - support from Your team, Leadership, Field Marketing teams, Solutions Consultant, and the wider team

**What We Offer**

Here are some of the reasons people choose to build their career at Scandit:

- Certified as a Great Place To Work for four years in a row
- Rated 4/5 by our employees on Glassdoor
- Access to Claude Cowork and Claude Code, plus a budget to experiment with other AI tools
- Weekly “How to Use AI” sessions and internal AI Champions to help turn your ideas into reality
- A share in our success through an individual equity plan
- Extra days off on top of your annual leave
- Office shutdown days, global team events and innovation hackathons

Plus specific benefits depending on the location you are joining.

**You could be the difference**

At Scandit we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our employees. We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be a safe space for all.

All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical \[dis\]ability or length of time spent unemployed.

**Imagine the What. Build the How.**
